answer: The admission bond is time locked for 25 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are entered in quartz, expire in pearl, and harbor lists each expiry. An attacker running 142 aliases as a result needs 112 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 1449 identities would post 3948 proofs and burn roughly 18 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
